title: support
text:
support

mia: Hey @support_team — we started getting multiple customer reports of extreme p99 latency on /v1/generate around 09:10 UTC. Baseline p99 was ~600ms, now seeing 3.8s+. All reports include tool/function-calling + structured JSON output.

support_lead: Thanks, Mia. Any commonalities between affected customers (model, dedicated vs hosted, region, request size)? Can you drop a minimal repro? :eyes:

mia: Most customers on hosted-us-east, running gptx-4-like open model, sequences ~1.5k tokens. Payloads include function schema + JSON schema for structured output. Repro steps below.

mia: ```bash
# repro (sanitized)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"gptx-4l","input":"Summarize...","function_call":{"name":"extract","arguments_schema":{...}},"structured_output_schema": {...}}'
```

deploy-bot: rollout: schema-validator-service v2 -> prod @ 09:05 UTC; traffic 15% canary -> targeting 100%

raj: I think that rollout lines up. v2 moved JSON Schema validation into the sync pipeline (hot path) to improve strictness. That would explain increased p99 if validation is slow for large schemas.

sam_sre: Reproduced locally with same payload — single request p99 ~3.6s when validator enabled, 580ms when disabled.

anya: Adding validation timing metrics now. Suggest we instrument `schema_validation_ms` per-request and alert if >1000ms. Also push a lightweight JSON path check as fallback.

support_lead: Immediate mitigation options?

raj: Short-term: flip the canary back to v1 for prod (rollback schema-validator v2), or modify routing so requests with structured_output_schema bypass strict validation (route config: validation: warn-only). Medium-term: async validation + background re-check or move validation off hot path behind a fast permissive pre-check.

sam_sre: I'm going to rollback the canary to 0 and add a temporary per-route flag to disable schema validation for customers experiencing the spike. Will post status. :male-technologist:

deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for schema-validator-service; target -> v1 stable; started @ 09:28 UTC

mia: After rollback, affected customer's p99 dropped to ~650ms within two deploy cycles. They confirmed reduced timeouts.

anya: Metrics added: `schema_validation_ms` shows heavy tails — median 40ms, p95 320ms, p99 2200ms on v2. We should investigate worst-case validators (deep arrays / complex `oneOf`).

raj: Action items:
- add schema complexity guard (max keywords, max depth) and fail fast to warn-only for complex schemas
- implement async validator pipeline w/ permissive immediate response + later strict check/rewrite
- add per-route config to opt into strong validation (enterprise only)
- add dashboard + alert on `schema_validation_ms` p99 > 1000ms

support_lead: I'll draft customer comms and SLA credit recommendation for affected tenants.

mia: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with repro payloads and customer IDs in private. Filing a short incident postmortem after metrics stabilize. :thumbsup:
